observations: Three photos show a white product box for a security camera.
The brand name 'OBIYKE' is visible in red text on the box in photo 0, photo 1, and photo 2.
The model 'T44' is clearly printed in red on the box in all three photos.
The box describes the product as 'Intelligent Solar PTZ Camera' with '4 LENS' and '4G LTE' features.
The box shows an image of a solar panel attached to the camera unit, with multiple lenses and a remote control.
Icons on the box indicate features: 12MP Ultra HD, IP66, Audio, Built-in battery, Auto track, and 3-PTZ Auto-rotate.
The text 'TrueColorView' is visible on the box in photo 2.
The box appears to be new and unopened, resting on a shelf or surface.
Watermark 'MR TRUST SOLAR' is overlaid on all photos.

risks.risk: The camera may be defective or not functional despite being new in box.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powered on, connected to 4G, and displaying live feed on a phone app.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different model.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual camera unit inside the box, showing the brand and model on the device itself.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not matching the box

risks.risk: The 4G SIM card may not be included or may be locked to a specific network.
risks.proof: A photo of the SIM card tray or the included SIM card, or a confirmation from the seller that the SIM is active and compatible with Nigerian networks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring additional SIM purchase

risks.risk: The solar panel may be non-functional or damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the solar panel on the actual camera unit, showing no cracks or damage, and ideally a photo of it charging the battery.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual camera unit inside the box, showing the brand and model on the device.
Video or photo showing the camera powered on and live feed on a phone app.
Photo of the included SIM card or confirmation that it is active and compatible with Nigerian networks.
Close-up photo of the solar panel on the camera unit, showing no damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an OBIYKE T44 solar security camera, and most claims are supported by the box. However, critical risks such as functionality, contents of the box, and SIM compatibility cannot be verified from the photos alone. Proof is needed to confirm the camera works, is included, and is usable in Nigeria.
